title: Not nearly as big as they sound
text:
Not nearly as big as they sound. I guess I need to adjust my mental expectations on this one. When I read "half gallon", I mentally see half of a gallon of milk.

These are not nearly that large. They are more like a large container of a dry spice. They will work just fine for some things, but not for what I had planned to use them for. Very lightweight.

So, don't think physical half gallon if you are thinking about buying these...think more along the lines of liquid measurement, 64 ounces. That's my best guess on what they were thinking.
